name: Squarespace Commerce
label: Squarespace Commerce APIs — Orders 1.0, Inventory 1.0, Products v2
description: Squarespace Commerce Orders 1.0, Inventory 1.0, Products v2 (URI /v2/commerce/products, not /2.0), Webhook Subscriptions 1.0. Partner/plan gated. Bearer API key. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (trigger) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event). Docs: https://developers.squarespace.com/commerce-apis/versioning
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API verb. EXACT: order_list | order_get | inventory_get | product_list | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port).

schema.label: id
schema.description: Resource id for get/update/delete path {id} when that operation needs it.

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Query-string parameter `cursor` for operations: order_list, inventory_get, product_list.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode. EXACT: order_list | order_get | inventory_get | product_list | trigger. Selecting trigger (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type bearer. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
